criteria.recurring_status: A regular team check-in where people report progress and blockers
criteria.project_working_session: Hands-on work on one project: demos, reviewing designs, agreeing build details
criteria.proposal_signoff: One person presents a proposal and asks others to approve it
criteria.vendor_or_partner: A conversation with someone from an external company (supplier, partner, reseller)
criteria.company_broadcast: A company-wide meeting where leaders share updates with everyone
criteria.planning_or_strategy: Setting direction, priorities or objectives across several areas
criteria.other: None of the above describes the meeting

criteria: One person talks almost the whole time
Mostly one person presenting, with a few questions
Active collaboration or debate, with people challenging and building on ideas

criteria.true: Participants explicitly agreed to a course of action, e.g. 'go ahead', 'we will do X', 'let's launch on the 23rd'
criteria.false: Options were discussed or information shared, but nobody explicitly agreed to do anything

criteria.true: An existing plan, date or earlier decision was changed, postponed or cancelled in this meeting
criteria.false: No existing plan, date or decision was changed

criteria.true: Next steps were given to named people by the end of the meeting
criteria.false: Next steps were left vague or without named owners

criteria.true: Nayem Reza took on or was given a new task during this meeting
criteria.false: Nayem Reza got no new task in this meeting; any Nayem work mentioned was already agreed before

criteria.true: Nayem Reza is responsible for a large deliverable, such as building or launching a product, site or system
criteria.false: Nayem Reza is not responsible for any large deliverable in this meeting

criteria.true: A task owned by Nayem Reza has a deadline within 7 days, stated as a date, a day or a word such as 'today', 'tomorrow' or 'Monday'
criteria.false: No task owned by Nayem Reza has a deadline within 7 days

criteria.true: Someone else's work is waiting on Nayem Reza to finish or deliver something
criteria.false: Nobody's work is waiting on Nayem Reza

criteria.true: A NEW blocker was raised in this meeting that could stop a deliverable or make it miss its deadline
criteria.false: No new blocker was raised; any problems mentioned were already known, minor, or resolved in the meeting

criteria.true: An existing known problem was reported as getting worse, overdue, or needing escalation
criteria.false: No existing problem was reported as getting worse or needing escalation

criteria: No deadline was discussed as being at risk
Deadlines are tight but described as on track
At least one deadline is described as likely to slip
At least one deadline has already been missed

criteria.true: Security or compliance work was discussed in substance: pen testing, audits, certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2), access control or compliance tooling
criteria.false: Security or compliance was not discussed, or only mentioned in passing, e.g. as a type of training or as a reason for something else

criteria.true: Money Voxsmart spends or would spend was discussed: costs, quotes, prices, budgets, contracts or software renewals
criteria.false: No Voxsmart spending was discussed; percentages of team time and revenue or sales pipeline figures do not count

criteria.true: A next step with an external supplier or partner was agreed, such as a call booked, a quote or document requested, or a list to be shared
criteria.false: No next step with an external supplier or partner was agreed
